notes.title: DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age – Definitive Edition Announcement
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age – Definitive Edition will be available on Steam this December 4, 2020!

The Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original release of the acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, and adds extra character-specific scenarios, the choice of playing with the original soundtrack or a grand orchestral version of the music, the ability to switch between 2D and 3D graphic modes, a Japanese voice-acting option, and much more! 

Learn more and pre-purchase at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295510/DRAGON_QUEST_XI_S_Echoes_of_an_Elusive_Age__Definitive_Edition]DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition[/url]

notes.title: All DQH2 Content Updates Are Now Live!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update on Steam Trading Cards
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/4874e47ede688f4b5ffd324a4569b9b59d9f53bf.png[/img]
EDIT: Steam Trading Cards are now available. We’re also adding an in game option to quickly exit out of the game on 25th May 2017. Thanks for playing Dragon Quest Heroes II! 

=====

Dragon Quest Heroes II has just been released on Steam and we hope you’re all enjoying the game so far!
You may have noticed that Steam Trading Cards are missing from the game but don’t worry, we will be adding them to the game as soon as possible. 

On a side note, when playing in full screen mode, if you want to quit the game quickly, the easiest way to do this is to press Alt-Tab and close the program if you have a keyboard ready. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/7f5417b02b2231323dcecceb18bc112e65849ab5.jpg[/img]

If you wish to enjoy the authentic Dragon Quest feeling then speak to the Chapel tender and end your adventure (you can also save your game here). A bit later into the game, you’ll have to cast the Zoom or Evac spell to return to Accordia to get to the Chapel too.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154712/09d472438b213bd34a8795dc944bb460cc347f29.jpg[/img]

That’s it for now but let us know if you run into any problems and we hope you enjoy Dragon Quest Heroes II!

notes.title: Dragon Quest Heroes II is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Today’s the day – Dragon Quest Heroes II is finally out on Steam! 

For those of you new to Dragon Quest – don’t fret! Dragon Quest Heroes II is set in its own world, with brand new characters and does not assume you have any knowledge of any previous Dragon Quest game, so you can go into it as a brand new, standalone game and have lots of fun! It’s a hack-and-slash, field roaming action RPG, and even includes 4 player online co-op!

You can pick from a huge selection of characters – some are from older Dragon Quest games (but again, don’t worry if you haven’t played any other Dragon Quest game – you’ll be introduced to the characters!) Change your vocation, which changes your fighting style, and even control some of the famous Dragon Quest monsters designed by veteran illustrator Akira Toriyama!

In Dragon Quest Heroes II you play as cousins Lazarel and Teresa who live in a world divided into Seven Realms in which peace has reigned for a thousand years. One day, while in the Kingdom of Harba they are attacked by the army of their hometown, Dunisia! Follow their journey to Accordia to meet the Supreme Sovereign of the Seven Realms to find a solution to bring back peace to the world!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - DRAGON QUEST HEROES II
notes.notes:
DRAGON QUEST HEROES II is Now Available on Steam!

DRAGON QUEST HEROES II is a hack-and-slash Action RPG that sends you on a new adventure to restore order to a once peaceful world filled with monsters and battles of epic proportions. Up to 4 players can play in cooperative multiplayer to defeat an unknown threat looming over the Seven Realms!
